# TDrive v3.1.2

This release improves media downloads, shared-drive navigation and settings, and
makes desktop update checks more resilient when GitHub rate-limits its API.

## Downloads and playback

- Use a downloadable YouTube player client on Android to avoid the 403 errors
  returned for some separate video and audio streams.
- Show the downloader's underlying error when setup, status checks or downloads
  fail, so a failed transfer is easier to diagnose.
- Package Android native libraries in a way that lets the bundled downloader
  runtime load its files correctly.

## Shared drives and source picker

- Group shared drives under a Shared folder in the Android and iOS drive switcher.
- Keep a drive joined locally when Telegram refuses a leave request, so the user
  can retry without losing cached drive data.
- Remove the duplicate inner focus border from the mobile Add a source fields.

## Settings

- Simplify General and AI Models, including removing the author credit line from
  General and its long AI Models description.
- Improve settings spacing and alignment on desktop and mobile.

## Desktop updates

- Fall back to the published latest release when the GitHub API is rate-limited,
  including releases that do not provide `release.json`.
- Recognize primary and secondary rate limits, honor retry headers, and reduce
  repeated update checks while GitHub is throttling requests.
